title: Alanine Aminotransferase (ALT)
description: Liver enzyme; elevated in liver damage.

title: Albumin
description: Protein indicating kidney/liver health or nutrition.

title: Alkaline Phosphatase (ALP)
description: Elevated in liver/bone disorders or bile duct issues.

title: Ammonia
description: High levels suggest liver dysfunction or metabolic disorders.

title: Amylase
description: Pancreatic enzyme; elevated in pancreatitis.

title: Antinuclear Antibody (ANA)
description: Autoimmune disease marker (e.g., lupus).

title: Arterial Blood Gas (ABG)
description: Assesses lung/kidney function and acid-base balance.

title: Aspartate Aminotransferase (AST)
description: Elevated in liver, heart, or muscle damage.

title: Bilirubin
description: Liver function marker; high levels cause jaundice.

title: Blood Glucose
description: Fasting: 70–99 mg/dL; screens for diabetes.

title: Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN)
description: Reflects kidney function/hydration; normal: 7–20 mg/dL.

title: Bone Density (DEXA Scan)
description: Diagnoses osteoporosis (T-score ≤ -2.5).

title: Brain Natriuretic Peptide (BNP)
description: Heart failure marker; higher levels indicate severity.

title: C-Reactive Protein (CRP)
description: General inflammation marker; high sensitivity (hs-CRP) for heart risk.

title: Calcium
description: Normal: 8.5–10.2 mg/dL; assesses bone/kidney health.

title: CD4 Count
description: Immune health in HIV; normal: 500–1,500 cells/µL.

title: Cholesterol (Total, LDL, HDL)
description: Total <200 mg/dL; LDL <100 mg/dL; HDL >40/50 mg/dL (men/women).

title: Creatinine
description: Kidney function; normal: 0.6–1.2 mg/dL (varies by muscle mass).

title: D-Dimer
description: Blood clot marker (e.g., DVT, pulmonary embolism).

title: Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR)
description: Non-specific inflammation marker; normal: <20 mm/hr.

title: Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate (eGFR)
description: Kidney function; normal: ≥90 (no chronic kidney disease).

title: Ferritin
description: Iron storage protein; low = deficiency, high = inflammation.

title: Folate (Vitamin B9)
description: Deficiency causes anemia; normal: >4 ng/mL.

title: Glomerular Filtration Rate (GFR)
description: Direct kidney function measurement.

title: Hemoglobin (Hb)
description: Oxygen-carrying protein; normal: 13.5–17.5 g/dL (men), 12–15.5 g/dL (women).

title: Hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c)
description: Avg. blood sugar over 3 months; diabetes: ≥6.5%.

title: International Normalized Ratio (INR)
description: Blood clotting time; therapeutic range varies (e.g., 2–3 for atrial fibrillation).

title: Iron
description: Normal: 60–170 µg/dL; assesses anemia or overload.

title: Lipase
description: Pancreatic enzyme; elevated in pancreatitis.

title: Magnesium
description: Normal: 1.7–2.2 mg/dL; critical for nerve/muscle function.

title: Mean Corpuscular Volume (MCV)
description: Red blood cell size; classifies anemia (microcytic/macrocytic).

title: Phosphate
description: Normal: 2.5–4.5 mg/dL; linked to kidney/bone health.

title: Platelet Count
description: Normal: 150,000–450,000/µL; low = bleeding risk.

title: Potassium
description: Normal: 3.5–5.0 mEq/L; critical for heart function.

title: Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA)
description: Prostate health; normal: <4 ng/mL (age-dependent).

title: Sodium
description: Normal: 135–145 mEq/L; imbalance affects brain/kidneys.

title: Thyroid-Stimulating Hormone (TSH)
description: Normal: 0.4–4.0 mIU/L; screens for hypo/hyperthyroidism.

title: Total Protein
description: Normal: 6.0–8.3 g/dL; reflects liver/nutritional status.

title: Triglycerides
description: Normal: <150 mg/dL; high levels linked to heart disease.

title: Troponin
description: Cardiac enzyme; elevated in heart attacks.

title: Uric Acid
description: Normal: 3.4–7.0 mg/dL (men), 2.4–6.0 mg/dL (women); high = gout risk.

title: Vitamin B12
description: Normal: 200–900 pg/mL; deficiency causes anemia/neuro issues.

title: Vitamin D (25-hydroxyvitamin D)
description: Normal: 20–50 ng/mL; deficiency = bone/metabolic risks.

title: White Blood Cell Count (WBC)
description: Normal: 4,000–11,000/µL; high = infection, low = immune issues.
